Maharashtra: Four booked for agricultural land fraud using fake documents in Hingoli
The alleged fraud came to light after a divisional vigilance squad investigated a complaint and found irregularities in the sale of a piece of agricultural land to a resident of Pedgaon village, an official said
Police have launched a further investigation to establish the role of each person involved in the matter. Representational Pic/File
Four people have been booked in Maharashtra’s Hingoli district for allegedly selling agricultural land using fake documents and without obtaining mandatory permissions, police said on Tuesday, reported the PTI.
The alleged fraud came to light after a divisional vigilance squad investigated a complaint and found irregularities in the sale of a piece of agricultural land to a resident of Pedgaon village, an official said.
